EXPLORE THE MODES

INFECTION

THE HUNT GROWS.

Every caught prop becomes a hunter. Props survive until time runs out. Hunters win by finding them all.

CAUGHT? SWITCH TEAMS.

LAST STAND

ONE LIFE PER ROUND.

Get caught and you're out until the next round. Win more rounds than the other team in a best-of series.

NO RESPAWNS.

RUSH

KEEP THE TICKETS.

Props respawn, but each catch costs the team a ticket. Hunters empty the ticket pool. Props hold on until time runs out.

RESPAWN. HIDE AGAIN.

VIP

PROTECT THE SECRET VIP.

One prop is the VIP. Hunters try to catch them. Props keep them hidden to win the interval. Caught props respawn.

ONE PROP MATTERS MOST.
